items.name: Dwarven War Axe (Broken)
items.description: This favored weapon of the dwarves has a large, ornate head mounted on a thick handle. This powerful axe can be wielded with one hand or two.

items.name: Chain Mail (Broken)
items.description: A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

defensiveAbilities.name: Consecration Vulnerability
defensiveAbilities.description: A relictner in a place of worship dedicated to a non-evil deity or on sacred ground, such as an area blessed by Anointed Ground, is Slowed 1.

defensiveAbilities.name: Lair Sense
defensiveAbilities.description: The relictner bonds with a single structure they consider their lair, such as a house, temple, or ruin. A relictner is aware of any creature that enters the lair, and the direction and approximate distance to the creature. If the lair is destroyed, the relictner can bond with a new lair by residing within a structure they own or claim for 1 week.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Weathering Aura
defensiveAbilities.description: 60 feet. The relictner radiates an aura of degradation. All objects in the area have their Hardness reduced by 10, to a minimum of 0, for as long as they remain in the aura and for 1 round after leaving it. The relictner can't deactivate this aura.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crumble
offensiveAbilities.description: The relictner erodes an object within 30 feet, dealing 3d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage to it, with a Basic DC 31 Reflex Saving Throw if the object is attended.

offensiveAbilities.name: Death Gasp
offensiveAbilities.description:
The relictner draws in a deep breath and holds it, temporarily suspending their biological processes and becoming undead. The relictner gains the undead trait and becomes immune to bleed, death effects, disease, Paralyzed, poison, and sleep. Any such effects the relictner is currently inflicted with are suspended but take effect again once they take a breath.

Death Gasp lasts as long as the relictner holds their breath (up to 12 rounds).

Effect: Death Gasp

offensiveAbilities.name: Demolition
offensiveAbilities.description:
The relictner bellows in fury, causing the surrounding structure to collapse. All creatures in a 30ft Emanation take 8d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage from falling debris (Basic DC 31 Reflex Saving Throw). A creature that fails its save is knocked Prone. The area becomes difficult terrain.

The relictner can't use Demolition again for 1d4 rounds.
